column1: # Xenoblade Chronicles 2, Nintendo Switch 2 Edition: program 1 of application 0100E95004038000's update 1114112 (SDK 21.4.4, Monolith engine, NVN2).
# Program 0 of that update is the Switch 1 game (profile 0100E95004038000). This program's own RomFS holds only dummy.bin: its game data is the bf2.arh / bf2.ard
# pair of DLC 98's update (0100E95004039062 v65536, NVN2 shaders), which it registers in the place of rom:/'s. See README.md.
# display version 3.0.1: the game requires it to equal DLC 98's dlcver.bin (main+0x265d30), and shows the system's add-on content version error otherwise
# main imports from subsdk0 and subsdk3 (movie); subsdk1 (DLSS) and subsdk2 (libc) supply nothing the host does not
# its own RomFS: one placeholder file (the game data is DLC 98's)
# The NPDM declares 96 MB of system resource (virtual address memory). nninitStartup and nnMain both run the allocator's setup (main+0xbddb40 → main+0xb78ed0), and each
# takes a 60 GB address region (nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion(&p, 0xf00000000), main+0xb7bdc0): the second ends at +121.07 GB of the alias region, so it takes a 128 GB one.
# Mac only: an iPhone has no such address space (README.md, open)
# nninitStartup maps 1 MB pages into its 60 GB address region until a map fails, to measure the memory it can have (main+0xb7be04): the map stops at the pool, as on Horizon
